The '''First Brigade''', also called the '''Restuss Brigade''', was an organization that patrolled and defended the city [[Restuss]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its destruction in the [[Battle of Restuss]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG:C1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 1: The Battle for Restuss</ref>

Titles and ranks within the brigade included [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[General/Legends|general]], [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], [[Commando/Legends|infiltrator]], [[Commando/Legends|marine]], [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Scout/Legends|scout]], [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]]. Members of the First Brigade usually wore gree-colored uniforms.<ref name="SWG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Restuss Brigade was fighting several local criminal organizations such as the [[Neo-Cobral]] and the [[Garyn Raiders]], with the support of the [[Narmle Militia]].<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The First Brigade is one of many [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) organizations in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. They could be found in and around the city of Restuss on Rori. Following the destruction of the city in [[2006]], the NPCs no longer appear inside the destroyed city but can still be found in the region around the city. While the NPCs are all named First Brigade Captain, First Brigade General, etc.. in the game and ''Star Wars Galaxies'' strategy guides, their faction is also called Restuss Brigade on the screen that shows a player's standing with the various factions in the game.
